q: What kind of work is Coffee & Creamers this week?
options: Seasonal adds across the whole set
explain: Seasonal adds land across the set: natural, bag, end caps, instant/can and Starbucks.

q: What do you do before cutting in Baby Food?
options: Check your POG for shelf height changes
explain: Smaller sets get tub shelf height changes and Shelf 5 drops one inch in most mainstream sets. The POG tells you which applies.

q: Every Baby Food set gets the flow change.
explain: The flow changes only where tubs and jars lead the set. Value and Hispanic stores keep their expanded jar section.

q: Why will Pure Protein multipacks have holes?
options: Some items are not being received
They were deleted from the set
explain: Some Pure Protein items are not being received right now. The holes are expected; set the rest of the POG.

q: Select the stores moving to a new store-specific 16 ft Sports Nutrition POG.
explain: Stores 23 and 28 move to the new store-specific 16 ft POG.

q: Which set is the priority this week?
explain: Pet Care is the priority set: Kompass at all 10 District 8 stores, with POG conversions and a department change.

q: Where do Wild Bird Food strips get recorded?
explain: Wild Bird Food strips at 23, 31, 53 and 391 are recorded under Pet Care.

q: The replacement tray for Implements & Brushes is not at the store. What do you do?
options: Start the set and add the tray later
Do not start; check with the cosmetics clerk, then let me know
explain: Do not start without the tray in hand. Check with the cosmetics clerk for a spare, then let me know. Delay is okay.

q: Tray labels for Cotton are not in the box. What do you do?
options: Follow store custom: UPLs on the trays or cut-down paper strips
explain: Cotton tray labels likely will not arrive. Follow store custom with UPLs or cut-down paper strips.

q: Old SRP comes off the shelf as soon as the new SRP items arrive.
explain: Leave the old SRP in place while it still has product. It still fits the shelf.

q: Select the District 8 stores converting to the Artisan with Asian bread POG.
explain: Stores 23, 31 and 658 convert. Keep branded rack strips in place and use Kompass strips only as a reset guide.

q: Who brings new fuel kiosk product out from the store?
options: The fuel center clerk, from the backroom
explain: Kompass does not move product between the store and the fuel center. Store management brings it out.

q: On the window wrap-around racks, where do the lighters go?
options: Always on the right, facing the kiosk from outside
explain: The racks run customer-facing, left to right, with lighters always on the right when you face the kiosk from outside.

q: On a mapping survey, which shelf color will you not find?
explain: There are no oyster shelves. Most are Sahara (beige) or Clear Coat (silvery gray). Use the color guide.

q: Which set next week is a produce set that gets done first thing?
explain: Salad Mix is a produce set, done first thing, and the salad identifier cards move with the product.
